artifacts.synopsis: The SJC found the complaint judicially out of order (20-2) because BCO 43-1 permits complaints only against acts of a court of the church, not against actions taken in a congregational meeting; the case involved complainants who alleged minor communicant members were wrongly prevented from voting on accepting their associate pastor's resignation, with concurring and dissenting opinions extensively addressing the question of minor communicant suffrage rights and the scope of BCO 43 jurisdiction.

artifacts.title: Brown v. Northern California Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: Northern California Presbytery adopted an abstract resolution declaring six different views on the diaconate permissible for ministers and Sessions; the SJC sustained the complaints and annulled the resolution, holding that no court may issue binding abstract decrees beyond its proper jurisdictional exercise. A concurring opinion analyzed each of the six diaconal views in detail and set out standards (the GUMP/Kniseley framework) for when diaconal assistant practices are constitutionally permissible.

artifacts.title: Deacons delegating the treasurer role to a non-deacon congregation member

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that delegating the treasurer's responsibilities to a non-deacon member of the congregation does not conflict with BCO 9-4.
